title: Palindrome Partitioning
description:
Cut the string s into one or more contiguous, nonempty pieces such that every piece reads the same forward and backward. Find every way to make those cuts; the original character order must remain unchanged.

Return each partition as its left-to-right array of pieces. Sort the outer list lexicographically by the piece strings (shorter matching prefixes first). For an empty string, return one empty partition: [[]].

Example 1:

Input: s = "aab"
Output: [["a","a","b"],["aa","b"]]
Explanation: The opening two a characters may be kept separate or grouped.

Example 2:

Input: s = "a"
Output: [["a"]]
Explanation: A single character is a palindrome.

Example 3:

Input: s = ""
Output: [[]]
Explanation: There are no pieces to check in the empty partition.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= s.length <= 12
  • s contains lowercase English letters

exampleTestCases.explanation: The opening two a characters may be kept separate or grouped.
A single character is a palindrome.
There are no pieces to check in the empty partition.
